description.p: Paint is a straightforward raster image editor for the Linux desktop, in the spirit of the classic Windows accessory: open a picture, draw on it, save it, and get on with your day.

ul.li: Pencil, brush with selectable tips, eraser and fill bucket
Line, curve, rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse and polygon
Text with font, size, weight, slant and alignment
Rectangular and free-form selection, with move, resize and crop
Flip, rotate, resize, canvas size, stretch and skew, invert colours
Deep undo and redo, bounded by a memory budget rather than a step count
Open and save PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, TGA and ICO; open WebP, PSD and Netpbm
Drag and drop files onto the window, and copy or paste images through the system clipboard
A restrained light and dark theme that follows the desktop
